disposition_reason: Table 1 prints triplicate mean ± SD (ppm) of As, Pb and Cd, and Hg as ND, for six Indian protein powders.

study.design: Online label survey of 110 protein powders; 6 Indian-made products with the most labelling violations analysed for metals in triplicate
study.market: purchased online from two Indian e-commerce platforms
study.method: MP-AES (Agilent 4200) after HNO3 hotplate digestion of 0.1 g in 10 mL; As 193.695, Hg 253.652, Pb 405.781, Cd 228.802 nm
study.qa: No CRM, recovery or blank results reported

findings.group: retail protein product 1 (sample code A), made in India
findings.notes: Mean of triplicates. Arsenic at 15-44 mg/kg by MP-AES in protein powder is far above usual levels for this matrix; analytical plausibility uncertain.
